decision: auth_store_observation stays PARTIAL/UNKNOWN: store identity and cross-store isolation are proven, but the account-level principal is not observable when the store is pinned explicitly. The fallback justification (stable orgId) does not apply because orgId is also null; no schema relaxation.
root_cause: with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR set explicitly, claude auth status returns loggedIn=true with email=null, orgId=null and orgName=null on the same binary/argv/env; the earlier manual check tested key presence only, not values. The difference is field values, not transport or parsing.
